Reductions

Source: R/numpy_core.R
jnp_reductions.Rd

Ports of jnp.sum, jnp.prod, jnp.max, jnp.min, jnp.mean, jnp.var, jnp.std, jnp.all, jnp.any, jnp.argmax and jnp.argmin. Axes are 0-based; NULL reduces over all of them.

Usage

jnp_sum(
  a,
  axis = NULL,
  dtype = NULL,
  out = NULL,
  keepdims = FALSE,
  initial = NULL,
  where = NULL,
  promote_integers = TRUE
)

jnp_prod(
  a,
  axis = NULL,
  dtype = NULL,
  out = NULL,
  keepdims = FALSE,
  initial = NULL,
  where = NULL,
  promote_integers = TRUE
)

jnp_max(
  a,
  axis = NULL,
  out = NULL,
  keepdims = FALSE,
  initial = NULL,
  where = NULL
)

jnp_min(
  a,
  axis = NULL,
  out = NULL,
  keepdims = FALSE,
  initial = NULL,
  where = NULL
)

jnp_amax(
  a,
  axis = NULL,
  out = NULL,
  keepdims = FALSE,
  initial = NULL,
  where = NULL
)

jnp_amin(
  a,
  axis = NULL,
  out = NULL,
  keepdims = FALSE,
  initial = NULL,
  where = NULL
)

jnp_all(a, axis = NULL, out = NULL, keepdims = FALSE, where = NULL)

jnp_any(a, axis = NULL, out = NULL, keepdims = FALSE, where = NULL)

jnp_mean(
  a,
  axis = NULL,
  dtype = NULL,
  out = NULL,
  keepdims = FALSE,
  where = NULL
)

jnp_var(
  a,
  axis = NULL,
  dtype = NULL,
  out = NULL,
  ddof = 0L,
  keepdims = FALSE,
  where = NULL,
  mean = NULL,
  correction = NULL
)

jnp_std(
  a,
  axis = NULL,
  dtype = NULL,
  out = NULL,
  ddof = 0L,
  keepdims = FALSE,
  where = NULL,
  mean = NULL,
  correction = NULL
)

jnp_argmax(a, axis = NULL, out = NULL, keepdims = FALSE)

jnp_argmin(a, axis = NULL, out = NULL, keepdims = FALSE)

Arguments

a

Array.

axis

Axis or axes.

dtype

Optional result dtype (the accumulation dtype of sum and prod).

out

Not supported (must be NULL).

keepdims

Keep reduced dimensions as size one.

initial

Optional scalar starting value of the reduction. max and min need it to reduce an empty array or to use where.

where

Optional boolean mask of the elements to include.

promote_integers

Whether integers narrower than the default integer are promoted to it (the NumPy rule).

ddof

Delta degrees of freedom: the divisor is N - ddof.

mean

Optional precomputed mean (with the reduced dimensions kept).

correction

Array API name of ddof (give one of the two).

Value

An array.
